steps.name: quiz-logic-data
steps.summary: Created 3 files + 2 test files. lib/config/temperamentQuestions.ts: 60 TemperamentQuestion items (3 age bands × 20 questions, 5 per axis), all EN/KO, both-positive tone. lib/config/temperamentPersonas.ts: 16 TemperamentPersona entries covering all 2⁴ combos — active/calm × social/shy × flexible/cautious × expressive/mellow — each with emoji, EN/KO name ('형용사+명사' pattern), 2–3 sentence description, 2–3 goodness-of-fit tips, and unique colorHue (index×22.5). Named examples from spec included: 🧭 Cheerful Adventurer (active-social-flexible-expressive), 🌙 Laid-back Observer (calm-shy-cautious-mellow), 🎨 Shy Artist (calm-shy-flexible-expressive), 🧩 Careful Leader (active-social-cautious-mellow). lib/utils/temperamentQuiz.ts: scoreQuiz() (majority-vote per axis, deterministic tiebreak, ignores invalid poles) + getPersonaCode() (activity-social-adaptability-reactivity format). Tests: 369 total passing (95 new), build clean.

steps.name: quiz-component
steps.summary: Created TemperamentQuizTool.tsx ('use client'). Phases: age-select (0–3mo → info text, 4 band buttons) → quiz (1 question/card, fade transition, progress bar) → loading (bounce 🍼 animation, 650ms) → result (persona card with colorHue-derived HSL background, confetti floating emoji overlay, tips list, share + restart buttons). Share URL: `${SITE_URL}${localeHref(locale, '/baby/temperament-quiz/result/${code}')}` — personaCode only, no raw answers. prefers-reduced-motion skips all animations and loading delay. analytics: tool_open on mount, calculate on result (ageBand payload), share on share. AnalyticsEventName unchanged. Accepts optional locale prop (Locale, defaults 'en'). lint/test/build all clean (369 tests passing).

steps.name: tools-config-page
steps.summary: Added temperament-quiz entry to tools-config.ts (disclaimerType: 'general', 4 FAQs, relatedToolIds: ['growth-percentile','sleep-schedule']). Added 'temperament-quiz' to relatedToolIds of sleep-schedule and height-predictor. Created src/app/[locale]/baby/temperament-quiz/page.tsx (Server Component) following growth-percentile pattern: generateStaticParams/generateMetadata with openGraph images field, SchemaBreadcrumb/SchemaWebApplication/SchemaFaqPage, TemperamentQuizTool, Description/HowToUse/Example/FAQ/DisclaimerBanner/RelatedTools/AdSlots. Inline quiz-specific disclaimer note added in description section. Build: 46 static pages clean. Sitemap includes EN+KO URLs. og:image verified as /og/default-{locale}.png. 369 tests passing.

steps.name: persona-og-images
steps.summary: 결과 공유 랜딩 라우트 32개(16코드×2locale) + 페르소나별 OG 카드 이미지 32개 생성. page.tsx: generateStaticParams로 routing.locales×TEMPERAMENT_PERSONAS 전체 조합, generateMetadata에서 /og/temperament/{code}-{locale}.png 고정경로 참조, 결과 미리보기(이모지+이름+설명+팁)+면책조항+CTA 버튼. opengraph-image.tsx: colorHue 기반 어두운 HSL 배경+장식 원+이모지+이름. postbuild.mjs: out/en/baby/temperament-quiz/result/ 디렉토리를 readdir로 동적 발견 후 EN/KO opengraph-image → out/og/temperament/{code}-{en,ko}.png 복사. 빌드: 110 정적 페이지 생성, 32개 PNG 복사 확인, lint/test(369) 모두 통과.
